findings.text: follow-on: the file was written although it is not among the node's declared write paths; the plan directs the never-a-start cases be updated so the gate stays green, but the dispatch did not name this file, so the exclusive scope was breached and a scope grant should be recorded.

follow-on: the added snapshot field reading time_budget from node.as_dict() is not covered by any test — the node's cases hand-build the snapshot with time_budget="30m", so a regression in this read from a real pointer stays green.
follow-on: the dispatch stated the done-when names no artifact and the node writes no evidence prose, yet the fragment carries a prose account and a measure table.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_live_pane_delivers_its_own_starts.py:83 fails when the follower_row_path change is reverted, but the added snapshot time_budget read at reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:1150 is untested because the cases hand-build the snapshot.
justifications.evidence: the gate log gate-head.log reads rev=847487a0e03260ab4a16b9e31d475aa1b71c96fb and its last lines read 2 failed, 554 passed, matching the manifest's recorded result.
